page.layout: One page of text, single column of verse; running head at top centre; no page number; no margin notes; a short line set right at the foot.

main_text.p:
Ferrea sox hæc illa Dei, quæ sicubi fractas
Hic illic celeri percurrit lumine nubes,
Et sonitus ciet horrificos mugitque tremendum,
Sulphureámque facem stridens agit igneaglauc
Fulgure, & infano rapidum somit impete fulmi
Quod iam corripiat gelidi iuga frondea Iura,
Pinguibus increpitans tadis, quà semita longe
Vltricis flamma signauit lumine montes,
Per totum lacrymosa sehens incendia Iuram.

Qua tibi mens, Epicure, malus timor snde repet
Téque Tuuq; grege miser occupat, srget & srit
Intus agens subigitque Deum, scelerate, fateris
Hic ille est opifex, rerum longe optimus auctor,
Qui circumfuso librauit in aere terras,
Quíque suas intra metas maria alta coercet
Omnipotens, serbóque tenet solidata potenti
Et cælum & medij gelidam liquidi aeris oram:
Humida qui gelida luna mouet incrementa,
Qui Solem regit, & campis immittit adustis
Opportunum imbrem, quum sicco languida cælo
Terra hiat, ambustis( heu )quú sitientia marcent
Prata comis, agris marcet seges arida culmis.
Nam pater e cælo humoris miseratus egentes,
Protinus accersit nubes, dextráque potente
Exprimit, & sitam reddit morientibus herbis,
Arboribúsque fatisque, soles ille arbiter & Rex.
Qui, rapidi licet indociles Aquilonis habenas
Laxarit, Iuramque sua de sede reuellat
Arduus, aut, srente Noto, per nubila sestus
Terribilis,

page.notes: Some words at the right edge are cut off by the scan (e.g. "aglauc", "fulmi", "oram", "Iuram"); a few letters are doubtful, notably "snde", "Tuuq;", "sehens", "sestus", "quú", and the marked words are as read. The page is set in a large italic/roman mix; italic passages were not distinguished in the transcription.
